retried.delegated: Technical, delegated (plan-07): the verifier's finding stands — format the reader-local time from Date's local getters (getFullYear/getMonth/getDate/getHours/getMinutes), zero-padded, ASCII digits, four-digit year, so Q-time's YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM holds in every locale and calendar

findings.record_quote: 페이지의 자바스크립트가 이를 독자 브라우저의 시간대로 바꿔 `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`로 보여주고
findings.tree_quote: new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).formatToParts(date); ... return `${values.year}-${values.month}-${values.day} ${values.hour}:${values.minute}`;
findings.why: The unspecified locale/calendar and `year: "numeric"` do not guarantee fixed four-digit Gregorian ASCII output. Valid years such as 0001 can render as `1-...`, and some browser locales use localized digits or calendars, so the required format is not guaranteed.
